Hustu pud ang íyang sulti, apan sa láing báhin, sayup pud siya,
What he said is true, but on the other hand, he’s also wrong in some ways.
odd in behavior, different from what one would expect.
Kaláin nímu nga dílì gánì mupahíyum inighinagbù nátù!
How odd of you not even to smile when we meet!
This perfume has a strange smell.
Ayaw nà siya kumpiyansáhi kay láin ra ba nag úlu,
Don’t trust him, because he’s somewhat crazy.
Láin siyag sabaw kay manáug manday nanghúkad,
He’s a strange fellow. He leaves just when they are serving dinner.
not of a good sort, bad.
The weather is no good now.
Láin kaáyu ug batásan nang íyang asáwa,
That wife of his has very offensive manners.
Ayaw siya bikla kay láin ra ba nag buut (úlu),
Don’t irritate him because he’s short-tempered.
Láin ug kamut tung ákung binatunan, Daghan ang nawā́,
Our servant was a thief. So many things disappeared.
Láig sabawng bayhána. Wà bayà kuy gipasabut nga dautan!
What a sensitive woman. I didn’t mean anything by that remark.

The people in Naga are dangerous. There are lots of vampires.
Nagbalunbálun pa man ka. Mau ra ka mag láing táwu,
You’re bringing food, as if you weren’t related to us.
Láin pay átù, tagadiin man tu ka?
By the way, where do you say you come from?
Ug muláin ang andar sa makina, pahunúnga,
If the engine develops a strange sound, turn it off.
Don’t take it the wrong way.
Nalaínan (naláin) siya tungud sa labihang kaguul,
He went off his rocker because of his extreme grief.
Naláin siya pagkabatì níya sa balità,
He reacted with distaste upon hearing the news.
I feel uneasy in my situation.
Ang barílis dílì igláin sa tulíngan,
The tuna is not unrelated to the mackerel.
Ang arti sa panugilánun dílì igláin sa arti sa pamintal,
The art of story writing is not unrelated to the art of painting.
separate oneself from the group, do s.t. s.w. else or at another time.
Milain ang dalágag káun sa laláki,
The girls ate apart from the boys.
Mulain ta kay lisud ug ípun ta sa mga bayaw,
We will live separately because it is difficult to live with in-laws.
Lainun nákù ni ug anhi kay dì nákù madala run,
I will come back for this some other time because I can not take it now.

Keep the unripe and the ripe ones separate.

We mustn’t marry our children off to those people because they are thought to be vampires.

There are all different kinds of food.
Lainlaínun nákù ang kulur sa bungbung,
I’ll paint the walls all different colors.

It will make a great difference for your skin if you use Camay.
